_comment: aac-touchid release pin (Macs): .chezmoiexternal.toml.tmpl installs it, the converge script's aac-touchid section reloads its LaunchAgent when the deployed binary or plist changes. Bump tag and both checksums together (SHA256SUMS on the release). pairSsh: per Mac, the ssh hosts whose aac it keeps paired; a host paired with several Macs asks the one in use (dot_local/bin/executable_aac). Each Mac always keeps its own aac paired, named after its host.
